NOTE

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ⚠️ | Self-review checklist: the "AI use policy" box is still unchecked, and so are "Calls out remaining decisions and concerns" and the manual testing items |
| ✅ | Description, "Fixes: #38436" and the fixture tests are in place (no screenshots needed, this isn't a UI change) |
| ⚠️ | How it was tested: the fixture tests are described, but there is no note on manual testing, and the author's "all passing" claim can't be checked because CI status is unavailable |
| ℹ️ | Another PR for the same issue, #39598, is already in maintainer review. #39280 is also open, and #39881 covers tabs in fenced code blocks. The author claimed the issue on the day this PR was opened |
| ℹ️ | Since the feedback there were 2 pushes (+1 line), with the same commit message |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to finish the self-review checklist, including the AI policy item; you may also want to decide whether this PR is needed given #39598.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! Please go through the self-review checklist again and check off the AI use policy item (only once it's true), and add a short note on how you tested this manually. Also, please take a look at #39598, which is already in review for the same issue, and say how this PR differs.
```
